.env.example.name: Env template
.env.example.description: Sample environment values for database, Redis, cache, and app URL.

.npmrc.name: npm settings
.npmrc.description: Local npm options used when installing front-end packages.

app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php.name: App wiring
app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php.description: Registers shared app services when the server starts.

bootstrap/app.php.name: App bootstrap
bootstrap/app.php.description: Starts the Laravel app and points it at the HTTP and console entry points.

bootstrap/providers.php.name: Provider list
bootstrap/providers.php.description: Lists which service providers load at startup.

composer.json.name: PHP packages
composer.json.description: Declares PHP dependencies and scripts for the Laravel app.

config/app.php.name: App settings
config/app.php.description: Sets the app name, timezone, locale, and encryption key source.

config/auth.php.name: Auth settings
config/auth.php.description: Configures how the app identifies signed-in users.

config/cache.php.name: Cache settings
config/cache.php.description: Chooses where cached data lives, such as Redis or the file system.

config/database.php.name: Database settings
config/database.php.description: Defines MySQL, SQLite, and other database connection details.

config/filesystems.php.name: File storage settings
config/filesystems.php.description: Configures local and cloud disks for uploaded or generated files.

config/logging.php.name: Log settings
config/logging.php.description: Controls where errors and app messages are written.

config/mail.php.name: Mail settings
config/mail.php.description: Configures how the app would send email if needed.

config/queue.php.name: Queue settings
config/queue.php.description: Chooses how background jobs are stored and processed.

config/sanctum.php.name: API token settings
config/sanctum.php.description: Configures personal API tokens used after sign-in.

config/services.php.name: Third-party keys
config/services.php.description: Holds credentials placeholders for outside services.

config/session.php.name: Session settings
config/session.php.description: Controls how browser sessions are stored and how long they last.

config/shortener.php.name: Shortener settings
config/shortener.php.description: Sets short-code length and how long redirect cache entries live.

package.json.name: Front-end packages
package.json.description: Declares Vite, Tailwind, and other browser build tools.

phpunit.xml.name: Test runner config
phpunit.xml.description: Tells the test runner which suite to run and which env to use.

public/index.php.name: Web front door
public/index.php.description: First PHP file the web server runs for every browser request.

routes/console.php.name: Console commands map
routes/console.php.description: Registers Artisan console commands for the project.

vite.config.js.name: Asset build config
vite.config.js.description: Tells Vite how to bundle CSS and JavaScript for the pages.
